main_text.p: quorum iudicia & querelæ non omnino contemnendæ: vel [illegible, ~10 letters] præcisione longioris conquestionis: vel significatio-ne firmitatis & constantiæ in rebus aduersis: vel denique [illegible, ~5 letters] voto, ut aliquan-do fortuna uti meliore liceat. Horum Collocatio querularum epistolarum.ve-rò ita collocatio instituitur:ut prima pars Exordium constet, vel querela & indignatione. lib.8. epist.12. lib.10. epist.1. lib.12. epist.3. lib.16. epist.11. lib.14. epist.3.18. Vel laude ac commendatione constantiæ & fidei eorum, ad quos scribimus. lib.12. epist.2. lib.14. epist.1. Vel excusatione rari-tatis, tarditatis, aut breuitatis literarum. lib.9. epist.11. lib.14. epist.2.4. Vel causis & occasione institutæ scriptionis. lib.10. epist.33. lib.11. epist.12. lib.14. epi.11.16. Pars altera propositio, vel querelam ipsam co-rinet. lib.14. epist.1. Vel adhortationem. lib.10. epist.1. Pars tertia Confirmatio institutæ querelæ rationes, & eorum quæ excitare eandem posse videtur, amplificationem completitur, petitá: aut ex adiunctis & circumstantiis personarū.lib.8. ep.12.lib.10. ep.33.lib.12. ep.3.lib.14. ep.1.2.3.11. page.notes: Greek word after "vel" (before præcisione) is not legible on the scan; the Greek after "denique" (with "voto") is also not legible. Printed "co-rinet" appears to be a printing error for "continet"; left as printed. "petitá" carries an accent as printed. The Collocatio note is in italics. Citation "epi.11.16." left as printed.
